enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Flaming Blast 6: This weapon burns with deadly magical fire, dealing 6d6 Fire damage on a successful hit, and an additional 6d6 Fire damage on a critical hit.
Incineration: This weapon stores the power of a raging inferno deep within. Occasionally, this destructive power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with massive fire damage.
Fire Absorption +36%: Passive: 36% Enhancement Bonus to Fire Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
